The '''Amorphiia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Amorphiia]] and was the home system of the [[Amorphiian]] race.

The Amorphiia system was known for its strict quality control for its products, as well as its high standards of long wear and durability.
